html:
Every construction project begins with a framework. At Dass Metal, we supply that framework with precision-engineered studs, tracks, channels, and accessories. From light gauge steel studs for non-load bearing partitions to heavy gauge studs for structural walls, we manufacture a complete range of products. Backed by Canadian quality, certified standards, and strict quality control, our products are trusted across Ontario by contractors, architects, and developers.

Non-Load Bearing Steel Studs (Light Gauge)

Our light gauge steel studs are a cost-effective alternative to lumber, used in drywall framing systems for residential and commercial interiors. These metal studs are:

  • Lightweight and easy to install.
  • Fire-resistant, adding safety to every project.
  • UL fire-rated and galvanized for superior durability.
  • Available in multiple widths, lengths, and flange sizes, giving contractors flexibility.

When paired with our steel track, these studs create dependable framing for walls and partitions that last for decades.

Load Bearing Stud Framing Systems (Heavy Gauge)

When projects demand more strength, our heavy gauge steel studs provide unmatched performance. Designed for curtain walls, structural walls, and roof or floor joist assemblies, these products:

  • Provide superior load-bearing capacity.
  • Offer precision for both interior and exterior framing construction.

Heavy gauge studs are trusted for mid-rise and high-rise projects where structural integrity is non-negotiable.

Standard Track Products

Our standard tracks are manufactured in various widths and gauges to suit any building design. Whether supporting light gauge drywall studs or heavy gauge load-bearing walls, these tracks provide alignment and stability.

Custom lengths are also available to meet project-specific needs.

Specialty Products for Advanced Construction

At Dass Metal, we understand that every project requires more than metal studs and steel tracks. That’s why we offer specialized components, including:

  • Slotted Deflection Track – Flexible and cost-effective, allowing movement without sacrificing stability.
  • Deep Track – Designed to accommodate deflection while maintaining structural strength.
  • Resilient Channel – Improves STC ratings, reducing sound transfer between rooms.
  • Furring Channel – Provides a secure way to attach finishes to structural walls.
  • Bridging/Carrying Channel – Adds stiffness and prevents buckling of studs.
  • Windbrace – Resists racking during construction while allowing exterior insulation.

Drywall Finishing Accessories

In addition to structural components, Dass Metal manufactures finishing accessories:

  • 90°/130° Corner Beads for clean, crisp drywall corners.
  • L-Trim and J-Trim for drywall edge protection.
  • Z-Bar to hold rigid insulation and support finishes.

These products ensure both durability and professional finishes for residential and commercial interiors.

Shaftwall Systems and Specialized Profiles

For specialized applications, Dass Metal offers:

  • Shaftwall/CH Studs – Used in elevator shafts, air ducts, and piping enclosures, delivering strength and fire-rated performance.
  • U-Flex Track – Designed for curved profiles.
  • Bridging Clips, Webslide Clips, and Deflection Side Clips – Engineered for quick installation and structural flexibility.
  • Flat Strips and Custom Profiles – Manufactured upon request to meet unique design requirements.

Ceiling Support Accessories

To complete drywall and ceiling installations, Dass Metal supplies:

  • Hanger Wire/Pencil Rods – Used for suspended ceilings and grid systems.
  • Tie Wire – 18-gauge galvanized wire for drywall and plaster construction.

Why Choose Dass Metal?

  • Complete Range: From non-load bearing studs to structural framing, Dass Metal has every component.
  • Flexibility: Products available in multiple lengths, widths, and flange sizes.
  • Canadian Made: Manufactured in Ontario, with compliance to Canadian standards.
  • Trusted by Contractors: Serving residential, commercial, and structural projects across Ontario.
  • Performance You Can Count On: Designed to save time and deliver consistent results.

At Dass Metal, we continue to support projects across Ontario with precision, durability, and certified quality—because building stronger futures starts with stronger materials.
